probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently Amended) An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve arranged to selectively allow compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve arranged to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; and control means for controlling the first and second valves to operate to selectively control the air pressure in the brake chamber in use, __wherein the control means comprises a microprocessor-based controller arranged to modulate the first and second valves based on real-time feedback from multiple sensors to achieve anti-lock braking functionality__.

2. (Currently Amended) The air braking unit of claim 1, further comprising __a plurality of first valves and a plurality of second valves, wherein the first and second valves are independently controllable__.

3. (Currently Amended) The air braking unit of claim 2, wherein the plural valves comprise __at least one larger valve arranged to allow large volumes of air to pass therethrough and at least one smaller valve arranged to allow passage of smaller volumes of air therethrough, said larger and smaller valves being operatively distinct in their flow characteristics__.

4. (Currently Amended) The air braking unit of claim 3, wherein the __at least one smaller valve is arranged to operate at high speed with response times of less than 100 milliseconds__.

5. (Currently Amended) The air braking unit of any preceding claim, wherein __at least one of the first and second valves is driven by a binary solenoid actuator that operates in discrete on-off states__.

6. (Currently Amended) An air braking unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the control means is arranged to receive control signals from __both a wheel speed sensor and an air pressure sensor for determining the pressure in the brake chamber, and to process said signals in real-time to modulate braking force__.

7. (Currently Amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6, wherein the control means is arranged to receive data from a vehicle speed sensor, and __to access stored reference data indicative of an optimum braking force for given vehicle and wheel speeds, and to dynamically control braking force based thereon using a feedback control algorithm__.

8. (Currently Amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the control means is arranged to determine, from the sensors and stored reference data, an optimum speed for each wheel and to control the braking force on each wheel in accordance with the calculated optimum speed, __wherein said determination includes calculating slip ratios and adjusting valve modulation to maintain slip within a target range__.

9. (Currently Amended) An air braking system comprising __at least one air braking unit according to any preceding claim; a pump for generating compressed air; and a central compressed air storage tank, wherein the air braking unit is in pneumatic communication with the central compressed air storage tank via a control valve arrangement__.
